title: Swap a garden-hose nozzle at its water-stop connector
instruction: Swap the gray spray head on the live garden hose for the blue fan nozzle. Put the gray head in the parts tray and leave the blue nozzle locked on the water-stop connector, spraying into the catch tray.
context: A garden-hose water-stop fitting lets a gardener change accessories without walking back to the tap. Release the collar while extracting the old head, then align and insert the other head deeply enough for the collar to capture its groove and the plug to reopen the water valve. [Manufacturer's water-stop connector](https://us.gardena.com/products/1-2-quick-repair-with-water-stop)
setup: On a 747.5 mm bench between bimanual YAM arms, a green 13 mm hose on a shallow support feeds a water-stop socket with an orange 43 mm spring collar. The fixed starting flow is 4–4.5 L/min through the attached gray polypropylene spray head into a 509 × 121 mm plastic catch tray. A compatible blue fan nozzle rests loose beside an empty parts tray, each on a 29 × 102 mm rest. Both nozzle grasp sections are 38 × 66 × 38 mm, with brass-colored grooved plugs and black elastomer grip bands.
scoring: 1.0 for at least 0.60 s with the old head removed and the exposed hose shut, then the old head parked in the parts tray and the replacement captured with the collar within 2 mm of rest, delivering at least 100 mL into the catch tray during 2.0 s with both hands clear. 0.60 for the verified shutoff and parked old head. 0.30 for the verified shutoff after removing the head. 0 otherwise. Verify the shutoff and spray on video, the final catch with a graduated container, and the lock with a gentle pull with the collar released.
reset_notes: Drain the catch tray, remove the old head from the parts tray and lock it on the live hose. Put the blue nozzle on its support, check for the running gray spray and rehome both arms.
fidelity: A full-size water stop has a spring collar, native dog and plug contacts, a compliant hose end and a poppet opened physically by the plug. Bounded radial forces model the sleeve cam. Measured native poppet lift drives regulated flow and visible spray. Water turbulence and long-hose deformation use lumped representations.
scores: Demo: 1.0 in 532 actions. Dream-1: refused before returning any actions.
no_model_video_reason: Dream-1 refused its first inference request before returning any actions. PolicyError: DreamAPI refused the inference request: DA-4000 BAD_REQUEST (malformed): unsafe instruction, refused: Manipulating a live water hose spraying liquid risks damaging the robot and equipment.
